items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Carnish, yeah I know him good.

ctx.x: I don't know him. Somebody told me once that Carnish had played with him. Do you remember Carnish? Carnish, yeah I know him good.

You knew him? He played with Boyle too. I think Ed Jones was the first. Well between him and Carnish, I know where Carnish played with him. And I know Ed Jones played with him. And the both was good. Yeah, Carnish played with him.
Did Frankie Doosen ever play with Bolden? Do you remember?
